scope: Família de efeitos de Tributo com alteração de LP: Zolga (ganho de 2000 após Tribute Summon bem-sucedida usando a carta; LP do controlador no momento do Tributo) e Gravekeeper's Cannonholder (Tributar outro monstro Gravekeeper como custo para causar 700 de dano; sem limite por turno). Adapter isolado, sem resolver central, catálogo, certificação, inventário, comandos, banco ou produção.

cards.name: Zolga
cards.officialText: If a monster is Tribute Summoned by Tributing this card: Gain 2000 LP.
cards.ruling: The controller of Zolga when it was Tributed gains the LP; a negated Tribute Summon does not trigger the gain.

cards.name: Gravekeeper's Cannonholder
cards.officialText: You can Tribute 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster, except "Gravekeeper's Cannonholder"; inflict 700 damage to your opponent.
cards.ruling: The Tribute is a cost, is not a target, may be face-down when its identity is known to the controller, and is not refunded if the effect is negated.

implementation.scope: Isolated TagDuel adapter and focused regressions; no central resolver integration, catalog admission, certification, release allowlist, database or Discord commands.

nextTask: Implementar adapter isolado e testes de Tributo/LP, incluindo controle vs. dono físico, Summon negado, custo não reembolsado, alvo face-down, múltiplas ativações e conservação de UIDs.
